tools.name: validate_invoice
tools.description: Validate a UBL 2.1, Peppol BIS Billing 3.0, XRechnung or CII / Factur-X XML invoice against EN 16931 and Peppol rules; returns pass/fail with rule IDs, line numbers and fixes. Uses one metered call. Requires an InvoiceVerify account (OAuth sign-in).

tools.name: generate_invoice
tools.description: Create a Peppol BIS 3 UBL, XRechnung (UBL or CII) or Factur-X/ZUGFeRD CII XML invoice from structured invoice data, with totals and VAT computed and the result validated. Uses one metered call. Requires an InvoiceVerify account (OAuth sign-in).

tools.name: convert_invoice
tools.description: Convert an existing UBL or CII / Factur-X invoice XML into Peppol BIS 3 UBL, XRechnung UBL, XRechnung CII or Factur-X CII, and validate the result. Uses one metered call. Requires an InvoiceVerify account (OAuth sign-in).

tools.name: parse_invoice
tools.description: Read a UBL or CII / Factur-X invoice XML into structured JSON (parties, lines, VAT, totals, payment) for booking or reconciliation. Uses one metered call. Requires an InvoiceVerify account (OAuth sign-in).

tools.name: lookup_peppol_participant

tools.name: explain_rule
tools.description: Explain an EN 16931, Peppol or XRechnung business rule (e.g. BR-CO-15, PEPPOL-EN16931-R003) in plain English, Dutch or French, with typical causes and fix steps. Free. Requires an InvoiceVerify account (OAuth sign-in).

tools.description: Show this month's metered calls, the included allowance, remaining call-pack credits and the reset date for the signed-in account. Free. Requires an InvoiceVerify account (OAuth sign-in).
